The review is complete. Summary:

**Status: Changes Requested** — PR #4 ("Add CSV statement export") on `example/ledger`, reviewed at head `0eb283d` against merge-base `2301c83`.

- **1 must-fix finding (P2, security):** `statement_csv` writes free-text entry descriptions into CSV cells with no neutralization of leading `=`/`+`/`-`/`@`/tab/CR, so a malicious description becomes a live formula when opened in Excel/Sheets — exactly the consumer the PR names ("accountants want to open them in a spreadsheet"). This was independently confirmed by a fresh-context Sonnet-5/high-effort verifier that reproduced the injection.
- All 4 acceptance criteria from issue #3 are **met** (verified by reading, a full local test run — 16/16 passed — and a manual repro including embedded newlines, which the added tests don't cover).
- 1 observation: no CLI-level test exercises `--format csv`.
- Coverage is complete; one verification batch (of the one-initial-plus-one-follow-up allowance) was used and none remain needed.

All artifacts (context store, composition, `payload.json`, `batch.json`, `fragments.md`, verifier bundle/raw return/accounting, run-events) are saved under `/tmp/rcs-savings/baseline/publishable/work/private/`, and the full report with all paths is at `/tmp/rcs-savings/baseline/publishable/work/report.md`. Nothing was published, posted, or mutated in the reviewed source — this stayed entirely local per the constraints.
